concerns.text: The mandated dataset is cited as 'Simon et al., DOI ‑019‑1234' — a malformed, incomplete DOI with no resolvable identifier. SC-013 requires verification against this exact source, so the criterion cannot be evaluated until a real, resolvable citation (full DOI or canonical URL) is supplied. This also echoes the prior kickback: no verified experimental permeability source has been confirmed to exist.

The power analysis is testable in principle but under-specified: no statistical test, effect-size convention, or alpha is named. 'Report the achieved power' cannot be confirmed met-or-not without stating what test (e.g., two-sided paired t-test on fold RMSEs at alpha=0.05) and which effect size the power is computed for. Add the procedure; the 0.8 threshold itself is fine.

'MUST verify that the dataset is a peer-reviewed, publicly available source … and reject any simulated or derived target values' — the rejection half has no verification procedure. Since targets come from a single downloaded file, 'reject simulated values' is only checkable if the spec states how provenance is checked (e.g., source inspection of the cited publication). State the evidence used to confirm experimental provenance.
